One rule, written once, pointed at from the four homes. Holds.

Holds.
- Card 27363 item 1 (no seat assignee at `pr_create`): os-dev.md L37 「PR ⛔ 不带 `assignees`,人经席位交棒才见 PR」, L60 (写预算: labels, ⛔ 无 assignees); ops.mjs `pr_create` row keeps `assignees` optional for the author-is-approver fallback; execute.mjs pins that a Tier H create reads no file list, sends no request and no assignee (approver-authored included). This PR's own open is the first instance (`assignees: []`, `requested_reviewers: []` read back by the dev and by the seat). Holds.
- Item 2 (in-flight PR reader): execution-duties L63 reads `head:claude/` open PRs + the card the body names; the dev measured no patrol reading PR assignees as ownership (check-handover: card assignees, pulls excluded; check-half-states: PR assignees only as H43's approver-coverage fallback). Holds.
- Item 4 (project thread does not perform the harness's post-create step): dispatch-runbook L140, quoting 「审核通过才会推送给我审核」; paid by old L136 whose clauses live at coordinator.md 三 L22–L24 (read: present). Holds.
- Item 5 (H43 timing): `h43HandoffReading` — `unread` (thread `null`) ⇒ UNJUDGED and quiet, `before` (no ACCEPT or no same-head PASS) ⇒ quiet, `due` ⇒ the existing coverage judgment; only `due` buys the review page; the summary line discloses read/due counts; a PASS whose head moved reads `before` (回等复核). The verdict word has one reader, explicit `VERDICT:` line first. Holds.
- **Must-fix (governed rule text ≠ the mechanism it describes):** SKILL.md L200 「`pr_create`/`pr_ready` 不请审不指派」 — but ops.mjs L1094 keeps `governedReview: true` on `pr_ready`, `GOVERNED_REVIEW_OPS` derives to `['pr_ready']`, and execute.mjs's battery pins that a `pr_ready` on a Tier H diff requests every uncovered `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` account (and assigns an approver-author). The PR body's 速读 「风险与回滚」 says the opposite of L200 (「`pr_ready` 仍保留受管请审兜底」) and matches the code. One of the two must give; the seat rules **text follows code**: the backstop at `pr_ready` fires only when the hand-off was not made (a Tier H `pr_ready` comes after approval, so with the hand-off made the union already covers both and it costs zero writes), it is the regime's safety net against a seat that readies without the hand-off, and removing it would widen this PR. L200 must say that `pr_create` requests and assigns nobody while `pr_ready` only fills what the hand-off left uncovered — in ≤120 B, net 0 lines (the four clauses of L200 kept or re-homed on L198–201, a dropped clause named in the report).

- None owed: `.claude/**` + `scripts/pm/**` publish nothing; `skip-changeset` correct; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial, matching both claims.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The order's hypothesis 1 held (the hand-off is the existing `pr_request_reviewers` op); hypothesis 3 adjusted by measurement (`locateReviewOfRecord` needs both threads; H43 reads the PR thread alone — a PASS on the card alone reads as BEFORE, under-report only, disclosed in the header). Accepted.
- Deviation 1 (H69 wording in the same file, made false by this PR) and deviation 2 (`latestContractReviewOnHead` returns `verdict`, additive) — in-file adjacency, accepted.
- Out-of-scope class b: AGENTS.md 〈Multi-agent working discipline〉 「the PR's assignee mirrors the card's, set by the executor at pr_create」 contradicted by os-dev.md L37 — Tier H, the maintainer's hand; the seat carries it (ACCEPT names the carrier).
- `test:repo` / lint / dogfood left to CI; check-runs on this head: 29 success, 20 skipped, `Test Core (1/8)` in progress at the reading — the skip judgement is read when the set is final.
- Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay; `mcp_calls: 0`; `api_writes` 4 (3 pushes, 1 relay create, 2 post-stamped); draft, assignees [], requested_reviewers [], no flip by anyone.

### ④ Design judgment

- Against the maintainer's 「应该是开发完了你审核通过才会推送给我审核」 and the four-axis frame: a human's inbox sees a PR only once the seat has reviewed it on the head they would read — the ask becomes the seat's own stroke after ACCEPT + PASS, the draft open summons nobody, the dev's PR carries no seat account, and the patrol row is re-timed so it reports the gap exactly when the hand-off is owed and not before (AI-error: the timing is read off the thread's records, not assumed; focus: no new gate, no workflow, one flag removed from one row; long-run: one rule in SKILL.md ③, five homes point at it). Holds, save the one text/mechanism contradiction above, which is exactly the kind of declared≠enforced sentence the regime refuses in governed text.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把「PR 推给人审」的时点改为 **席位 ACCEPT + 现 head 契约复核 PASS 俱在案之后**:请审成为席位的交棒动作(中继 `pr_request_reviewers`;作者是审批人时 `assign`),dev 开 draft PR 不带 `assignees`,中继 `pr_create` 不再在开 PR 那一刻请审或指派(`pr_ready` 保留受管请审兜底,只补交棒漏下的审批人,交棒已做则零写);落地时仍欠复核的 PR 在落地 head 复审、发现逐条立新卡;巡查 H43 只在交棒已到期而无人被请时才报。
- 为什么改:您的指派清单被没人复核过的 draft 填满,请审在席位审完之前就发出(「这个是技能的bug,应该是开发完了你审核通过才会推送给我审核」);三张 PR 在 PASS 之前或缺席时就被推到您面前并挂了 auto-merge(「没有完成复审就推送给我审核了」)。
- 风险与回滚:只改技能文本(7 个 `.claude` 文件,行数与字节均在天花板内)、中继表的一个标记位(`pr_create` 行的 `governedReview` 移除)与一条只报不拦的巡查行;不新增门禁、不碰 workflow。回滚 = revert 本 PR 的四个 commit。Tier H 的批准与合并仍是您的点击。
